C-REPORT-HONESTY.Summary: Make the tool's own report surfaces agree about facts on disk: one shared loose-event membership for status and the archive gate (F14/F15), Correction 171 archive-identity reading for MustExist (F16), lifecycle-path exclusion from the scope audit (F11/F11.2), richer apply-gate absence diagnostics (P0.7), and a mode-aware lint framing line for baseline expectations (P0.9) — without silencing true complaints and without rewriting archives.
C-REPORT-HONESTY.Problem:
RM-GOVERNED-PATH phase P0's remaining work and four findings recorded during P0's own execution are one defect family: a surface states something about the ledger or the bundle that another surface contradicts. That is the product's thesis — the agent cannot lie to the model — turned inward. Measured at HEAD of the derivation (and re-checked for this authoring pass):
F14. evaluateArchiveGate (gates/core.ts) computes no-open-epoch from listLooseEvents and records the detail string "run/ empty". On this repository, archive/C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY/run/ contains NaN-T-001-opened.xml (SHA-1 c0cc8899c264381766a18918e2109b5e05693893). listLooseEvents correctly skips it (EVENT_FILENAME / orphan class); the *permit* is right; the *sentence* is false. The same false sentence is already durable in that bundle's archived Decisions.
F15. ngrace status reports the same archived bundle as open=1. countOpenEpochs (grace-status.ts) uses readdirSync().filter(endsWith(".xml")). Two definitions of loose-event membership, disagreeing about one directory. D8.8 made open epochs visible; the counter never shared listLooseEvents' membership rule.
F16. detectConfidentlyWrong (review/core.ts) checks MustExist with bare existsSync. expandScopePathsForArchiveIdentity (Correction 171) applies to ObservedWriteScope only. Archived plans that MustExist their own active/<id>/… artifacts are true under corr 171 and false under the bare check. Measured on this repository: ngrace review reports exactly two review.confidently-wrong errors — C-RECOVER-FOLDABLE and C-CALIBRATION-COMMAND-EVIDENCE MustExist of their own active/spec.xml paths.
F11 / F11.2. The scope audit raises review.scope-outside-write-scope for the CLI's own lifecycle writes (run/*, run-ledger.xml, run.xml). Fold deletes the events it folds, so porcelain lists deletions too. Measured at 23 errors during one close — enough to block the pre-verdict review. Commit-before-review is a process workaround; the audit still misclassifies tool-owned ledger state as agent out-of-scope work.
P0.7. gate.apply.no-verdict reports neither where it looked, how many Verdict entries it found, nor why the newest did not qualify. The plan allowed a race fix; the derivation reproduced 50 write-then-apply cycles with zero race hits. This is a diagnostics rewrite only — no flush.
P0.9. When an active approved plan carries failing BaselineAssertions (e.g. MustNotExist while the thing still exists), default lint text presents them as generic errors with no lead line that they are expected while C-* is in progress.
The membership split is the spine: a repair that makes status and the archive gate *happen* to agree while still computing membership in two places has not fixed F14/F15 — it is the defect in remission. One definition with two consumers is required, extracted so grace-status never imports grace-cursor.

Goals.Goal: One extracted loose-event membership definition (foldable loose events + parallel orphan inventory, D8.7) consumed by both ngrace status and evaluateArchiveGate (and available to recover, which already uses the listLooseEvents / listRunOrphans pair today).
Archive-gate no-open-epoch detail is honest: never "run/ empty" when run/ has orphans; still refuse when foldable loose events remain; name orphans when permitting over an orphan-only run/.
status reports open=0 for orphan-only run/ and an explicit orphan signal so the orphan does not become invisible; open≥1 when foldable loose events exist.
detectConfidentlyWrong applies Correction 171 archive-identity expansion to MustExist disk paths (same-id active↔archive only), clearing true claims on archived plans without editing archives.

Scope audit excludes any bundle's CLI lifecycle artifacts (.ngrace/changes/{active,archive}/C-*/run/**, run.xml, run-ledger.xml) from review.scope-outside-write-scope, including cross-bundle porcelain (fold of A must not error a review of B), while real out-of-scope authored paths still fire.

Apply-gate absence diagnostics name path looked at, entry count, and why the newest did not qualify (P0.7). Mode-aware lint text leads with a baseline expectations framing line while baseline assertion failures remain errors (P0.9).

On this repository after the change, ngrace review on a clean tree is genuinely clean of the F16 confidently-wrong pair, and status no longer shows C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY open=1 solely for the NaN orphan — without silencing checks.

Constraints.Constraint: Binding: p0-report-honesty-derivation.md (accepted derivation); decisions.md F11, F11.2, F14, F15, F16; plan.md P0.7 and P0.9; Correction 171; D8.7; D8.8 (open vs folded distinction retained, membership fixed); A29.2 / F1; D9 (ledger writes append-only — nothing here rewrites a recorded event file); D5.5 (CHANGELOG.md not in scope — new codes named in the commit body).

One bundle. gates/core, review/core, and the membership extract each carry two items; splitting costs more coordination than it saves. Spec only in this authoring pass (F4 two-stage). status remains "draft"; approval is a human act. Do not author plan.xml until the spec is approved.

Shared membership definition is extracted into an existing src/artifact/* module so grace-status does not import grace-cursor. Prefer M-ARTIFACT-TYPES (already imported by status and gates via artifact/paths|types; Path today src/artifact/types.ts / co-located paths helpers) as the host LINKS target — a new source file under src/artifact/ is allowed if it declares LINKS to an existing graph module. **No new graph module, no new .ngrace/graph/ entry, and no new V-M-* anchor.** If the plan concludes a new module is required, stop and report rather than invent graph/verification ownership.
P0.7 is diagnostics only. Do not spec a write-then-read flush; the race was not reproduced (0 hits / 50 cycles in the derivation).
Baseline assertions stay errors. P0.9 changes framing only; severity and evaluation of BaselineAssertions under current mode are not weakened.

Historical archive Decision strings that already say "run/ empty" are not rewritten. Archives under .ngrace/changes/archive/ and docs/plans/archive/ are never edited. The NaN orphan at archive/C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY/run/NaN-T-001-opened.xml (SHA-1 c0cc8899c264381766a18918e2109b5e05693893) is preserved evidence — tests use copies; never mutate the live file.

F11 exclusion covers **any** bundle's lifecycle artifacts under .ngrace/changes/{active,archive}/C-*/(run/**|run.xml|run-ledger.xml), not only the reviewed change id. Do not exclude plan.xml, spec.xml, or arbitrary .ngrace/changes/** paths.

gate --dry-run is out of band (--record false covers read-only evaluation). C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE (draft, no plan) owns three-exit ledger reads in gates/ledger.ts territory — do not absorb that work here.

Overlap note: C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE declares AffectedAreas M-GATES and M-REVIEW but has no plan, so no DurableScope exists and no scope.durable-overlap warning arises today. If that bundle is later planned with overlapping write scope on gates/* or review/*, a collision is expected and must be recorded then (sequential OWS / F10.2 style) — known now rather than discovered at plan time.
Evidence doctrine: red-first regressions for each AC. Measure denominators with their own commands when reporting counts or ratios (F12.2). Do not hand-edit CHANGELOG.md (D5.5).

NonGoals.NonGoal: F12 — documenting that fold requires a terminal event in ngrace-execute SKILL.md (and packaged mirror). Execution-contract documentation; P1 / RC-4.
F9.8 — documenting that honest red-first requires cursor attempt in its own round trip before the production edit. Same P1 documentation surface as F12.
C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE scope: three-exit ledger reads (absent / unreadable / ok) for wrapperFromLedger and related gates/ledger.ts surfaces.
Implementing gate --dry-run, rejecting unknown gate flags, or changing default record=true behaviour.
Rewriting historical archived Decision detail strings (including "run/ empty" on C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY); deleting, renaming, or hand-editing the NaN orphan or any other archived run/ file.

Treating orphans as open epochs (would reverse F8.1 archive-with-orphan preservation). Silencing review.confidently-wrong globally. Adding run/ to ObservedWriteScope as the "fix" for F11. Downgrading baseline assertion severity to satisfy P0.9. Flush/race "fix" for P0.7.
New graph modules, new V-M-* verification anchors, or CHANGELOG.md edits (D5.5). Skills/plugin packaging changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-MEMBERSHIP-ONE-DEFINITION: Foldable loose-event membership and parallel orphan inventory are defined in **exactly one** implementation (the extracted shared definition under src/artifact/, re-exported or imported by consumers). Both ngrace status (open-epoch / orphan reporting) and evaluateArchiveGate (no-open-epoch) consume that definition — they do not each maintain a separate membership predicate. **A repair that leaves status and the archive gate computing membership separately has not fixed F14/F15, even if both surfaces currently agree on every fixture.** Agreement of independent copies is the defect in remission, not the repair. Proof is by construction (shared import / single module under test), not solely by comparing outputs. grace-status must not import grace-cursor to obtain membership.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-TOKEN-ORPHAN-TRIPLE: On this repository (or an equivalent fixture copy that preserves the shape), after the change: (1) archive/C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY/run/ still contains NaN-T-001-opened.xml with SHA-1 c0cc8899c264381766a18918e2109b5e05693893; (2) evaluateArchiveGate / gate archive --record false permits no-open-epoch and the requirement **message is not** the string "run/ empty" — it states that there are no foldable loose events and names the orphan (name and/or class); (3) ngrace status reports open=0 (or omits open) for C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY **and** surfaces an explicit orphan signal for that bundle (count and/or name) so the orphan is not invisible. This single subject exercises F14, F15, and their counterweights together. Tests must not mutate the live NaN file.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-STILL-REFUSES-LOOSE: Given ≥1 foldable loose run/ event (positive-integer EVENT_FILENAME membership), evaluateArchiveGate **refuses** with no-open-epoch unsatisfied. Honest wording must not weaken the gate into permitting open foldable epochs. (F14 counterweight.)
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-STATUS-OPEN-FOLDS-WITH-GATE: A fixture with only orphan xml under run/ → status open=0 plus orphan signal. A fixture with a real foldable loose event → status open≥1. Status and evaluateArchiveGate agree on whether an open *foldable* epoch exists, via the shared definition in AC-MEMBERSHIP-ONE-DEFINITION. (F15.)
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-MUSTEXIST-ARCHIVE-IDENTITY: For a plan resolved under archive/<C-ID>/ whose MustExist names .ngrace/changes/active/<C-ID>/<artifact> and that artifact exists under archive/<C-ID>/, detectConfidentlyWrong / ngrace review does **not** emit review.confidently-wrong for that claim (Correction 171). The same check **still emits** review.confidently-wrong when the path is genuinely absent under both active and archive aliases for that id, or when the path names a different change id whose file is absent. A global active→archive string replace for unrelated change ids fails this criterion. No archive file content is edited to clear the finding. (F16 + counterweight.)
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-LIFECYCLE-EXCLUSION: Given porcelain (or --changed-files) that includes only lifecycle paths matching .ngrace/changes/{active,archive}/C-*/(run/**|run.xml|run-ledger.xml) for **any** change id(s), and ObservedWriteScope that does not list them, the scope audit reports **zero** review.scope-outside-write-scope on those paths — including when the reviewed --change id differs from the bundle whose lifecycle files appear (fold of A must not error a review of B). Given an additional out-of-scope production or docs path (e.g. src/secret.ts), that path **still** raises scope-outside. Excluding all of .ngrace/changes/**, or requiring run/ in ObservedWriteScope to pass, fails this criterion. (F11 / F11.2 + counterweight for real out-of-scope authored work.)
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LEDGER-INVALID-STILL-CATCHES: F11's lifecycle exclusion does not suppress structural ledger validation. A deliberately malformed run-ledger.xml Allocation or Event that today raises ledger.invalid-allocation or ledger.invalid-event (grammar / lint catalog) still raises that code after the change. Scope-audit silence on lifecycle *paths* is not silence on ledger *content* integrity. (F11 counterweight for hand-edited ledger corruption.)
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-APPLY-VERDICT-DIAGNOSTICS: Given plan status=approved and no usable Verdicts entry (no ledger, missing Verdicts section, or empty Verdicts), evaluateApplyGate / gate apply --record false refuses with gate.apply.no-verdict and the requirement or issue detail names (1) the ledger path looked at or that run-ledger.xml is missing, (2) how many Verdict children were found (0 for absence), and (3) why the newest did not qualify (absent vs invalid with reason). A message that is only the catalog title ("Apply Requires A Recorded Review Verdict") or only "no Verdicts section entry" fails this criterion. After recordReviewVerdict and immediate evaluateApplyGate, decision is permit when other requirements hold — no flush required. (P0.7.)
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-BASELINE-LINT-FRAMING: Given an active approved plan whose BaselineAssertions include a failing MustNotExist (or other baseline assertion) and default text lint output, formatTextReport **leads** with a line stating N baseline expectation(s) expected while C-* is in progress (wording may normalize whitespace). The underlying assertion.* issues remain present as **errors** (not deleted, not downgraded to warning or zero). A fix that removes or skips baseline evaluation, or prints the line without correctly counting baseline-sourced issues, fails this criterion. Archived plans' baselines stay syntax-only. (P0.9 + counterweight.)
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-DOGFOOD-REVIEW-CLEAN: After the change, on this repository at a clean working tree: (1) ngrace review --path . reports **no** review.confidently-wrong findings for the two archived MustExist active/spec claims (C-RECOVER-FOLDABLE, C-CALIBRATION-COMMAND-EVIDENCE) — measured pre-fix at 2 errors / 2 findings of that code; (2) ngrace status does not report C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY open=1 solely because of the NaN orphan, and does surface the orphan; (3) bun run ngrace lint --path . is 0 errors and 0 warnings. **A result that is "clean" only because checks were disabled, globally suppressed, or taught to ignore the claims without applying Correction 171 / the shared membership definition fails this criterion.** Clean by looking away is not clean.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SUITE-AND-LINT: Red-first regressions cover each AC above; bun test for touched packages green; bun run validate:ci green; bun run ngrace lint --path . remains 0 errors and 0 warnings. No edits under docs/plans/archive/ or .ngrace/changes/archive/ (except normal append-only Decision recording on active work if a gate is run during verification — not required for this bundle's product criteria).

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit and CLI regressions that fail before the fix and pass after: shared membership single-definition construction; C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY orphan triple (archive detail honest, status open=0 + orphan signal, NaN SHA preserved on copies); archive refuse with real loose events; MustExist archive-identity silence vs genuine absence still fires; scope audit lifecycle exclusion for any C-* including cross-bundle porcelain, with real out-of-scope still firing; ledger.invalid-allocation / ledger.invalid-event still raised on corrupt ledger content; apply no-verdict diagnostics path/count/reason; baseline lint framing line with errors retained. Dogfood: ngrace review --path . clean of the two F16 confidently-wrong errors; status honest on C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY; ngrace lint --path . 0/0. Existing V-M-GATES, V-M-STATUS, V-M-REVIEW, V-M-LINT-CORE, V-M-CURSOR, V-M-ARTIFACT-TYPES command surfaces; no new V-M-*.

Assumptions.Assumption: Module ids confirmed against .ngrace/graph/main.xml (measured: 19 M-* modules under GD-MAIN): M-GATES Path src/gates/core.ts; M-STATUS Path src/grace-status.ts; M-REVIEW Path src/review/core.ts; M-LINT-CORE Path src/lint/core.ts; M-CURSOR Path src/grace-cursor.ts; M-ARTIFACT-TYPES Path src/artifact/types.ts (co-located artifact helpers such as paths.ts already LINKS M-ARTIFACT-TYPES). No invented module ids. M-LINT-TYPES is intentionally not claimed unless the plan adds a LintIssue provenance field there — framing can live entirely in M-LINT-CORE.

Prefer hosting the shared membership definition under M-ARTIFACT-TYPES (new or existing src/artifact/* file with LINKS M-ARTIFACT-TYPES). M-GRAMMAR remains an alternate host if the plan finds types/paths unsuitable; either is an existing module. A new graph module is a stop-and-report, not a silent add.

Pre-fix dogfood measured for this authoring: ngrace review --path . → Findings: 2 (errors: 2), both review.confidently-wrong on the two archived MustExist active/spec paths; ngrace status shows C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY epochs=1 open=1; ngrace lint --path . → 0 errors, 0 warnings; NaN orphan SHA-1 c0cc8899c264381766a18918e2109b5e05693893. Denominators for review finding codes were read from the full command output (not a truncated match list).

listLooseEvents and listRunOrphans currently live in src/grace-cursor.ts (M-CURSOR). Extracting them (or their membership core) into src/artifact/* means M-CURSOR becomes a consumer/re-export site — hence M-CURSOR is in AffectedAreas even though the long-term home is artifact.

ledger.invalid-allocation and ledger.invalid-event are already raised by grammar validation of run-ledger.xml (src/artifact/grammar.ts; lint catalog entries exist). The F11 counterweight relies on that surface remaining live; this bundle does not invent a new hand-edit detector if grammar already covers the malformed-ledger case.

Exact status orphan signal shape (orphans=N vs named list vs both) is left to the plan; the property "explicit and visible in status output" is binding. Exact diagnostic string templates for P0.7 and F14 are left to the plan; the required information content is binding.
C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE remains draft/spec-only during this work; its future DurableScope is assumed to touch M-GATES / M-REVIEW and would overlap if planned concurrently — recorded in Constraints.
